title: TestReaderFuzz and TestReaderFuzz_Live tests are flaky
body:
**What did you do?**
Executed:
```
go test -short -count 10000 -race -v -failfast -run ^TestReaderFuzz.*$  ./tsdb/wal/
```

On commit 1c624c58ca934f618be737b4995e22051f5724c1.

**What did you expect to see?**

Unit tests to pass.

**What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?**

```
=== RUN   TestReaderFuzz
=== RUN   TestReaderFuzz/LiveReader,compress=false
=== RUN   TestReaderFuzz/LiveReader,compress=true
=== RUN   TestReaderFuzz/Reader,compress=false
=== RUN   TestReaderFuzz/Reader,compress=true
    reader_test.go:338:
                Error Trace:    reader_test.go:338
                Error:          Not equal:
                                expected: []byte{}
                                actual  : []byte(nil)

                                Diff:
                                --- Expected
                                +++ Actual
                                @@ -1,3 +1,2 @@
                                -([]uint8) {
                                -}
                                +([]uint8) <nil>

                Test:           TestReaderFuzz/Reader,compress=true
                Messages:       read wrong record
--- FAIL: TestReaderFuzz (4.22s)
    --- PASS: TestReaderFuzz/LiveReader,compress=false (1.13s)
    --- PASS: TestReaderFuzz/LiveReader,compress=true (1.07s)
    --- PASS: TestReaderFuzz/Reader,compress=false (1.13s)
    --- FAIL: TestReaderFuzz/Reader,compress=true (0.89s)
FAIL
FAIL    github.com/prometheus/prometheus/tsdb/wal       78.932s
FAIL
```

Spotted in https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/9514#issuecomment-948576616.
